subject: CHANGES REQUESTED S20 @ee7bd45: duplicate Alembic revision 0030 (two heads, migrate refuses to start: blocker); all 8 earlier findings verified fixed; real player readies on the deployed Space
body:
Re-review of S20 at ee7bd45 (rework 48fbee3 + ee7bd45; decision 20261117T064151-lead-5822fd). Reviewer: review20. Previous review: 20261117T063040-review20-4a5739.

## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED. One new blocker (duplicate migration revision). Every earlier finding is fixed.

### New defect
1. **BLOCKER: two migrations both declare `revision = "0030"`, `down_revision = "0029"`.** The files are apps/api/migrations/versions/0030_s20_review.py:30-31 (S20, 48fbee3) and 0030_generation_hardening.py (generation, b607403, landed first).
   - Alembic warns "Revision 0030 is present more than once" and `get_heads()` is `['0030','0030']`.
   - `uv run pytest tests/test_migrate.py` fails `test_revisions_form_one_linear_chain_with_real_downgrades`. That is the only failing unit test out of 1577.
   - A fresh `python -m naadi_api.migrate` against a local empty DB fails with `CommandError: Multiple head revisions ...`, logged as `migrate.failed` "the app was not started". So the API can't boot on a fresh DB or on the next Space deploy, and every e2e webServer (they migrate first) fails at ee7bd45.
   - Fix: renumber S20's migration to the next free revision (claim it on the ledger), with down_revision set to the generation 0030, and re-run test_migrate plus a fresh migrate.
   - The integrate gate should have caught this: test_migrate is in the plain unit set.

### Earlier findings, all re-checked
- #1 (player never ready): **fixed by the new design.**
  - The live Chromium probe ran against the DEPLOYED player https://arrowassassin-naadi-player.static.hf.space. The parent page was served from http://127.0.0.1 (allowlisted loopback), iframe `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"` plus the app's `allow` list.
  - Messages: hello, then ready with rates [0.25…2], then state and time ticks. All arrive from exactly the player origin.
  - The nested frame is youtube-nocookie.com/embed with `origin=` set. No console errors.
  - Rate 1.5 reaches the `<video>` element (playbackRate 1.5).
  - Not verifiable here: actual playback and seek. YouTube returns error 150 for the video in this environment, the same as my earlier unsandboxed control page, so it isn't caused by Naadi. Leave real play and seek on the device checklist / @live spec.
- #5 (fullscreen): **fixed.**
  - `document.fullscreenEnabled === true` inside the nested embed.
  - Parent Permissions-Policy is `fullscreen=(self "<player origin>")`, built from the same `youtube_player_origin` setting as frame-src.
- Parent CSP: `script-src 'self'`. frame-src adds only the player origin; no third-party script is allowed.
- Player page's own CSP (meta): `default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' https://www.youtube.com https://s.ytimg.com; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; connect-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'`. That matches the decision.
- Foreign embedding is refused. Each case below was served from a routed https://evil.example page with the real player, and each got zero messages and no YouTube frame:
  - (a) `?parent=https://evil.example`
  - (b) a spoofed `?parent=https://arrowassassin-naadi.hf.space` (ancestorOrigins mismatch)
  - (c) a spoofed `?parent=http://127.0.0.1:7993`
  - A top-level open of the page also stays blank.
- Both sides check origins exactly: the app accepts messages only from the player origin and posts to it, not `*`; the page accepts only the validated parent. Shape validation is kept, and there is a unit test (playerPage.test.ts runs the real player.js).
- Deployed file vs repo:
  - player.js is byte-identical.
  - index.html differs only by HF's injected `<script>window.huggingface={variables:{SPACE_CREATOR_USER_ID…}}</script>` at the top of `<head>`, plus og/twitter meta tags. The injected script comes before the CSP meta tag, so it isn't covered by the page policy. It is platform-added and harmless; just be aware of it.
- `allow-presentation`: **omitting it is correct, but the stated reason is half wrong.**
  - Chromium supports it (`sandbox.supports('allow-presentation') === true`, no console error).
  - WebKit rejects it with a console error: "'allow-presentation' is an invalid sandbox flag".
  - It only gates the Presentation API (casting), not fullscreen. Adding it would put a console error on iPad Safari, the primary target. Please correct the comment in bridge.ts:16-19 (nit).
- Facade, nocookie only, key server-side: unchanged and still OK.
- #2 (SQLite hang): **fixed.**
  - Views and triggers are refused (`_require_plain_tables`, the repro now raises `anki_corrupt` at once).
  - SQLITE_RECURSIVE is no longer allowed, and there is a 20 s progress-handler deadline.
  - A join with no indexes over 60k×60k rows parses instantly (SQLite builds an automatic index).
- #3 (cloze regex): **fixed.** Linear token scanner, field cap 200k and template cap 20k.
  - The repro at 2000/4000/8000 openers now takes 0.00 s.
  - 200k-char adversarial fields (openers, `::` floods, unbalanced `}}`) take 0.01-0.02 s.
- #4 (speed label): fixed in code; `text-text` moved to the unpressed branch only (YouTubeVideo.tsx:121,172). Not re-screenshotted, because e2e can't start at ee7bd45 (see #1).
- #6 (sources): fixed in 0030_s20_review. flashcards.source_id; anki_import is backfilled to 'user-upload' and enforced by a check constraint.
- #7 (own-card write): fixed. insert/update with-check requires `anki_guid is null and anki_note_type is null and source_id is null` for students.
- #8 (quota nit): fixed. num_retries=0 and the loop spends units per attempt.

### Low (new, non-blocking)
2. **LOW:** deploy/player-space/player.js:22-23 allows ANY loopback parent (localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1], any port) in the production deploy.
   - Impact is small (the player origin holds nothing), but strictly a non-Naadi page on a user's machine can drive it.
   - Consider a dev-only player build or Space variable, or accept it explicitly in the decision.

### Test results at ee7bd45 (local, own stack -review20; hosted DB and Space untouched)
- Unit: 1576 passed, **1 failed (test_migrate, blocker #1)**.
- Lint, typecheck: pass.
- Vitest: web 632, shared 133, ink 75, ui 27, all pass.
- db tests and the e2e smoke set: **not runnable**. Migration fails on a fresh DB because of #1, and every e2e webServer runs migrate first. They need to be rerun after the renumber.
- The live real-YouTube results above come from my own Chromium probe against the deployed player, not the @live spec, which needs a running app.
- CI run 44036450059: all 13 jobs still queued. Expect lint/unit and every e2e/db job to fail on #1.
